name: LLMCheck: Apple M5 Max (128GB), MLX, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset). M5 Max, MLX, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M, TTFT 0.6 s, per-request decode.
notes: The repo's target-class model on the target-class chip. Ollama run of the same model/quant gives 48 tok/s — the MLX-vs-Ollama spread on an MoE is ~13%.
